# buckley.ca

> The official personal homepage of Sean Buckley — a small, static two-page website.

buckley.ca is a minimal static site (built with Astro) belonging to Sean Buckley.
There are two pages: a home page and a contact page. There is no blog, store, or
application — it is a personal landing site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.buckley.ca/): Landing page showing the buckley.ca logo.
- [Contact](https://www.buckley.ca/contact): A form to reach Sean Buckley by email.

## Contact

- To get in touch, use the contact form at https://www.buckley.ca/contact.
